sources.name: Building Access Location Description Code List
verified_facts: The code list is associated with the Building Access Location Description attribute.
It constrains semantic labels for access points.
semantic_limits: A code-list match does not prove the point lies within an exact parcel or at an elevation extremum.

sources.name: OS NGD Land Theme
verified_facts: The theme contains Land, Land Point, Landform, Landform Line and Landform Point feature types.
Land cover describes physical or biological surface, distinct from land use.
semantic_limits: Land-cover classification is not a continuous elevation surface or legal parcel definition.

sources.name: OS NGD Land Features Collection
sources.role: land collection feature-type and supply contract
verified_facts: The collection contains five land and landform feature types.
It excludes features exclusively represented in buildings, structures, transport and water collections.
semantic_limits: Collection completeness rules do not prove DEM pixel completeness inside a parcel.

sources.name: OS NGD Land Feature Type
sources.role: land polygon and exclusion hierarchy contract
verified_facts: Land is a polygon for surface areas not otherwise captured as specified building, rail, road/path, structure or water features.
The feature type carries schema-version and land-cover attribution.
semantic_limits: A Land polygon is a classification partition, not an HMLR boundary or elevation measurement.

sources.name: OS NGD Land Point Feature Type
sources.role: small land feature point and capture-specification contract
verified_facts: Land Point represents land information captured as points and includes capture-specification metadata.
Filtering availability differs by attribute and service.
semantic_limits: A land point is not a DEM cell centre, terrain extremum or parcel representative height.

sources.name: OS NGD Landform Point Feature Type
sources.role: small morphology point and identifier contract
verified_facts: Landform Point represents a distinct physical morphology too small for a Landform polygon.
It is commonly associated with former mineral workings.
semantic_limits: A morphology point label does not provide measured elevation or a complete terrain surface.

sources.name: Landform Description Code List
verified_facts: The code list is used by the Landform Description attribute.
It includes descriptive classes for physical morphology.
semantic_limits: A morphology description is categorical and must not be converted into numeric slope or height difference.

sources.name: Landform Value Code List
verified_facts: The code list is associated with the Landform attribute on Land features.
It constrains permitted semantic values.
semantic_limits: A permitted label does not establish location accuracy, elevation or parcel containment.

sources.name: OS NGD Land Demonstrator
sources.role: land layers, formats and attribution demonstration contract
verified_facts: The demonstrator describes the five land feature types and available CSV/GeoPackage representations.
It illustrates attribution and landform concepts.
semantic_limits: A demonstrator or visual example is not a source distribution or candidate measurement receipt.

sources.name: OS NGD Structures Theme
sources.role: structure theme identifiers and embedded-height scope
verified_facts: The theme contains Compound Structure, Field Boundary, Structure, Structure Line and Structure Point.
Height attribution exists only for specified structure classes and field-boundary dimensions.
semantic_limits: Partial structure height coverage must not be treated as universal or as bare-earth terrain height.
